t: An AI add-on that runs small chatbots and vision models on a Raspberry Pi 5.
steps: Buy the AI HAT+ 2 from Raspberry Pi or a reseller such as Adafruit, SparkFun or PiShop.us.
Set up a Raspberry Pi 5 with Raspberry Pi OS on a microSD card.
Fit the stacking header, spacers and heatsink from the box.
Connect the PCIe ribbon cable and press the HAT onto the Pi.
Follow the official AI HAT+ guide to install the Hailo software.
Try an object detection example in rpicam-apps with a Pi camera.
Set up hailo-ollama with Open WebUI and chat with Llama 3.2 1B.
meta: Open Code. From $200. Easy to find.
